_comment: Optional deployment release proposal. Set a new semantic version and notes before deploying; Avenue Guard will DM the configured owner and publish it only after approval. Leave version blank when no automatic proposal is needed.
title: Public Recommendation Clarity
summary: Refines public level pages with private rank bands, precise lifecycle semantics and a responsive Geometry Dash presentation
changes: Replaced public exact queue position and queue size with server-derived Top, High, Standard and Lower priority bands
Separated public recommendation, outreach and outcome states so Rated is never presented as an outreach status
Rebuilt the desktop hero around a safe content column while preserving the level image and diagonal GD Avenue composition
Added relative accessible timestamps, safe uploader display, tier-accent Level ID copying and bottom-of-page sharing
Added an evidence-aware Geometry Dash-style progress timeline with terminal withdrawn and unavailable states
Expanded the public API privacy allowlist and removed score, CP, rank, requester, reviewer and private outreach data
Added API, percentile, lifecycle, responsive layout, copy, share, image fallback and accessibility regression coverage
